title: 009在你这里，她到底快乐吗
slug: 年少情深被辜负他跪了我不要了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“我管不管得住，不是你说了算！”

李铭烨的脉搏差点跳断，就连视力也跟着模糊几分，他闭上眼睛，喘出几口粗气后才冷静。

此时他心底只剩一丝冷硬的悔意。

早知道潘廷旭回国，会一步步侵入他和林萧的生活，撬动他的底线，当初他绝不会手下留情！

“潘廷旭，你以为藏得严实？只要我把真相摊开，让林萧知道一切，你觉得她还会去你的星野传媒？”

电话那端传来刺耳的冷笑，“是吗？告诉她真相之后，你觉得她会怎么想你？”

“别以为我不知道，你和她现在的关系很危险，她随时都会离开你。”

潘廷旭的这两句话，精准地刺在李铭烨心上。

一旦林萧知道他从头到尾都在阻挠她独立，不愿让她拥有属于自己的事业与底气...

他仅存的温情与体面，会在林萧心中彻底崩塌。

届时潘廷旭不过落个念旧相助的名头，而他李铭烨，则会彻底坐实自私的恶人身份。

孰轻孰重，李铭烨分得清楚。

“好，但那你别以为我没有别的方法！”

电话那端沉默了。

就在李铭烨以为潘廷旭终于无话可说时，耳边却传来了对方的叹息声。

“李铭烨，你有没有想过一件事。”

“什么？”

“你怕我给她工作，怕她离开你，怕她不再属于你。你什么都在怕，但你有没有怕过，她不快乐？”

李铭烨拧了拧车钥匙，轻踩油门单手握住方向盘，“我们夫妻之间的事，不需要你来操心。”

话音落下，他挂了电话。

车厢里安静了几秒，那句“你有没有怕过，她不快乐”还悬在空气里，像一根倒刺，扎进去的时候不疼，却怎么也拔不出来。

李铭烨盯着挡风玻璃外昏沉沉的灯光，心被揪了一下。

但也仅是一瞬，下一秒，他心底的那股郁气层层堆积，一个沉稳且体面的对策，已然成型。

而此时的林萧，虽然心里烦躁得很，但还是强迫自己一遍又一遍的刷题。

现在这样好待遇的工作比登天还难，她必须拿下。

等事业稳定，能独自撑得起妈妈和弟弟的一片天，她就有了真正的话语权。

有了话语权，就可以主导自己的人生。

【嘟嘟】

林萧瞥了眼躺在电脑旁的手机，上面弹出微信通知。

"I can control it, it's not you who has the final say!"

Li Mingye's pulse almost skipped, and even his vision became blurry. He closed his eyes and took a few deep breaths before calming down.

At this time, there was only a trace of cold regret left in his heart.

If he had known that Pan Tingxu would invade his and Lin Xiao's lives step by step when he returned to China, and would affect his bottom line, he would never have been merciful!

"Pan Tingxu, do you think it's well hidden? As long as I reveal the truth and let Lin Xiao know everything, do you think she will still go to your Hoshino Media?"

A harsh sneer came from the other end of the phone, "Really? What do you think she will think of you after telling her the truth?"

"Don't think I don't know. Your current relationship with her is very dangerous. She will leave you at any time."

Pan Tingxu's two words struck Li Mingye's heart accurately.

Once Lin Xiao knew that he had been blocking her independence from beginning to end, unwilling to let her have her own career and confidence...

His remaining warmth and dignity will completely collapse in Lin Xiao's heart.

By then, Pan Tingxu will only be remembered as a helper, and Li Mingye will be completely confirmed as a selfish villain.

Li Mingye could clearly distinguish which one was light and which was more serious.

"Okay, but don't think that I don't have any other methods!"

There was silence on the other end of the phone.

Just when Li Mingye thought Pan Tingxu finally had nothing to say, he heard the other party's sigh.

"Li Mingye, have you ever thought about something?"

"What?"

"You are afraid that I will give her a job, that she will leave you, that she will no longer belong to you. You are afraid of everything, but have you ever been afraid that she will be unhappy?"

Li Mingye turned the car key, stepped on the accelerator lightly and held the steering wheel with one hand, "You don't need to worry about the matters between us as husband and wife."

After the words fell, he hung up the phone.

The carriage was quiet for a few seconds, and the phrase "Have you ever been afraid, she is unhappy?" still hung in the air, like a barb that didn't hurt when it went in, but couldn't be pulled out.

Li Mingye stared at the dim lights outside the windshield, his heart twitching.

But it was only for a moment. The next second, the depression in his heart accumulated layer by layer, and a calm and decent countermeasure was already formed.

At this time, Lin Xiao, although he was very upset, still forced himself to answer the questions over and over again.

Nowadays, a job with such a good salary is more difficult than reaching the sky. She must win it.

Once her career is stable and she can support her mother and brother on her own, she will have real say.

With the right to speak, you can take charge of your own life.

【Beep】

Lin Xiao glanced at the mobile phone lying next to the computer, and a WeChat notification popped up on it.
